author: GameSpot
description: Check out the latest Indie Fan Fest showcase from The MIX and Digital Bandidos on February 19, at 10 am PT. The showcase will spotlight unreleased indie games launching demos in the upcoming Steam Next Fest. Find new favorites worthy of your wishlist as we share exclusive new game reveals, world premiere trailers, and more.
title: Indie Fan Fest Showcase 2026 Livestream
